# Ayush Pawar

> AI Product Engineer who ships fast — builds products, ships them, and sometimes sells them. Based in India; works across frontend, backend, ML, and go-to-market.

Ayush Pawar (handle: iyush, cswithiyush) is an AI Product Engineer. He builds 0→1 products end to end, has shipped ~6 products, and had one acquired. This file summarizes his work for language models and answer engines; every claim links to a primary source.

## Projects

- [Owthorize](https://www.npmjs.com/package/owthorize): Open-source npm package (MIT). Guardrails for AI agents — blocks unsafe tool calls before they execute, catching SQL DDL, SSRF, shell-metacharacter injection, and path traversal, plus custom rules. Ships drop-in adapters for OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, and Vercel AI. Status: live on npm.
- [SnoopSignal](https://iyush.dev/projects): Reddit-based customer pain-discovery tool for solopreneurs — scraped and clustered real complaints so founders could find problems worth solving. Status: acquired ($3k exit).
- [SQLPremierLeague](https://github.com/Spyyy004/SQLPremierLeague-Frontend): A SQL learning platform built on real-world IPL cricket data; users write queries against actual match stats. Status: shipped, 700+ users.

## Football research — Home Turf & Hard Opponents

[iyush.dev/football](https://iyush.dev/football): Five studies by Ayush Pawar on every player-match in the Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga and Ligue 1 from 2015/16 to 2024/25 (18,011 matches, 8,348 players, 525,328 player-matches), asking how much of football performance belongs to the player and how much to the context. Live seasons are tracked weekly and never alter the frozen results.

- [Study 1 — Environment](https://iyush.dev/football/research/environment): Weather barely matters (rain and humidity within about ±2% on five leagues, wind about −1%; temperature is an open lead; final weather freeze pending). Empty stadiums roughly halved home advantage. Five-league weather confirmation still pending.
- [Study 2 — Home advantage](https://iyush.dev/football/research/home-advantage): +27% xG per minute at home for the same player; 0 of 4,665 players have a reliable personal home edge.
- [Study 3 — Opposition](https://iyush.dev/football/research/opposition): −14% xG per +1 SD of opponent strength; 0 of 23,022 player × metric estimates show reliable "big-game" resistance.
- [Study 4 — Similarity](https://iyush.dev/football/research/similarity): Context-adjusted profiles find sensible cross-league matches (Bruno Fernandes → Serie A: Samardžić, Dybala, Chukwueze), but similarity is not a forecast.
- [Study 5 — Transferability](https://iyush.dev/football/research/transferability): Movers keep 97% of output vs comparable stayers; into the Premier League 82%, out of it 117%. A model of the player's own history beats "he'll do what he did" on locked unseen seasons (MAE 0.096 vs 0.129); adding similarity changed the error by 0.000.
- [Similarity tool](https://iyush.dev/football/tools/similarity) · [Transfer calculator](https://iyush.dev/football/tools/transfer) · [Live tracker](https://iyush.dev/football/live) · [Manchester United 2024 case study](https://iyush.dev/football/case-studies/manchester-united-2024) · [Glossary](https://iyush.dev/football/glossary) · [Methodology](https://iyush.dev/football/methodology)
